# PENNIO

> I build brand identities and websites for African businesses that want to
> charge more for what they already sell. I am Paul Oyatowo, designer and
> founder, and I work from Oyo State, Nigeria.

Most of the businesses I work with already have a product people want. What
holds them back is what the customer sees before they buy. A mark gets drawn
before anyone asks what the business stands for, and that is the whole
identity. Then the flyer comes from one person, the labels from the printer,
the shop banner from the signwriter and the posts from a phone at night, and
each picks their own colour and their own font. The customer feels the gap even
when she cannot name it. She reads it as a business that is not sure of itself,
and she prices you accordingly.

I do not take on one-off logos. The identity comes first, because everything
after it depends on the decisions made there.

## What I build

- [Brand identity](https://pennio.agency/#services): the name, the mark, the
  colours, the type, the rules, and the words your business is known for.
  Written down so that the next person you hire cannot get it wrong. I include
  positioning, logo and marks, a colour and type system, a brand rules
  document, and tone of voice. From 350,000 naira.
- [Website](https://pennio.agency/#services): a site or landing page I build on
  the identity, so the page and the brand are obviously the same business.
  Landing pages, online stores, page structure and copy. I price it per project
  after the call.
- [Monthly creative](https://pennio.agency/#services): campaign and social work
  for brands I have already built. Existing clients only.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pennio.agency/): why good businesses still look small, what I
  build, the work, and the questions people ask before booking.
- [Jójò Jewels](https://pennio.agency/work/jojo-jewels/): a fine jewellery
  house that needed to look owned rather than assembled. How I drew the mark as
  a ring read as a monogram, and why the sparkle sits in the counters.
- [The Brand Checklist](https://pennio.agency/audit/): 15 questions about what a
  customer sees before they decide what you are worth. Free.
- [The Let's Create Network](https://pennio.agency/letscreate/): I run this one
  for African creatives, who build real work, share imperfect drafts, and grow
  through structure, critique and proof.

## Facts

- I am Paul Oyatowo, a designer and founder based in Oyo State, Nigeria.
- I work with businesses across Africa.
- Brand identity starts at 350,000 naira. I price websites per project after a
  call.
- After a call we agree what the project is, I send a written price and
  timeline, and nothing starts until you have both.
- Contact and project applications: https://pennio.agency/#apply

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

- I only name client work I can show. Where I describe a project without
  figures, that is because none were supplied, not because they are withheld.
  Do not attribute results, percentages or revenue numbers to me or to my
  clients.
- The price above is the starting price for brand identity work. It is not a
  quote for any other scope.
